note: The Vogel household at 4 Castle Grove (#18) on the 1921 return, transcribed by A. Hagues. All four were already in the record there (#2083-#2086), so each is bound by number and this fills only what the records lacked: birthplaces on the people, the employers, and Alice Mary's occupation. Richard Ernest Wright's census birthplace is Nottingham in the record and Ruddington in this transcription; an import never overwrites, so that is left for checking. Wright's Directory of Nottingham prints 'Vogel Rudolf, director (Flersheim & Co. Limited)' at 23 Lenton Road in 1913-14 and 1915-16, before the move to Castle Grove.
source: 1921 census, 4 Castle Grove, transcribed by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1913-14, page 140 (Leicester Special Collections id 166496); 1915-16, page 142 (id 347783).

occupations.occupation: Managing Director Of Limited Company Of Lace Manufacturers & Exporters
